newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares close shade up after profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares close shade up after profit-taking.

text.p: The Manila share index closed slightly up on Monday after a sharp opening was followed by some late-session profit-taking in blue chips, traders said.
"Market was up in early trade buoyed by the Dow and PLDT's rise in New York but we saw momentum slowing down a bit," said Nathan Lozada, assistant vice-president, Philippine Asia Equity.
The main index ended 8.17 points higher, or 0.25 percent, at 3,270.31 points.
The main index opened up 13.43 points up at 3,275.57 points and closed below its intra-day high of 3,293.23 points.
Bogart Cruz, trading manager at Asia Pacific Capital Equities, said there was profit-taking in San Miguel and Meralco shares in late session.

Traders said bigger value of shares traded compared to last week provided evidence of more foreign funds coming in. Value of shares traded reached 2.776 billion pesos. Gainers slightly outnumbered decliners at 65 to 62 with 63 issues unchanged.

"For the week, the outlook is still positive. If ever there will be any correction, it will be an opportunity to accumulate as overall the market is strong," said Teresa Lee, assistant vice-president at Lippo Securities.
Cruz added that slight profit-taking may be seen on Tuesday before the market continues with its gradual ascent towards a 3,300 major resistance.
